name: Navigation Rulebook
summary: Menus, wayfinding, search, footers and URLs that let people find things and know where they are.
check: Find three key pages from the home page without search, on phone and desktop.
Tab through the header and mobile menu with the keyboard.

sources.title: NN/g: Hamburger menus and hidden navigation

rules.title: Navigation visible on desktop
rules.text: On desktop, show the main sections as visible links in the header. Hidden menus are found later and used less.

rules.title: Few, clear top-level items
rules.text: About four to seven top-level items named in the visitors' words, ordered by importance.

rules.title: Show where people are
rules.text: The current section is marked in the navigation (`aria-current="page"`), and deeper pages show breadcrumbs.

rules.title: Logo links home
rules.text: The logo in the header links to the home page on every page.

rules.title: One primary action in the header
rules.text: The header carries at most one primary button (Book, Buy, Contact); everything else is a link.

rules.title: Search for larger sites
rules.text: Sites with more than a few dozen pages or products have a search field that is visible, forgiving and fast.

rules.title: A footer that works
rules.text: The footer repeats key links: contact, opening hours or support, legal pages, social profiles, a short sitemap.

rules.title: Accessible mobile menu
rules.text: The mobile menu opens with a labelled button, traps focus while open, closes with Escape and returns focus to the button.

rules.title: URLs for every state worth sharing
rules.text: Tabs, filters, search results and opened items that people may share or revisit have their own URL.

rules.title: Mystery-meat navigation
rules.text: No icon-only navigation without labels, and no clever names ("Explore", "Universe") instead of plain ones ("Work", "Pricing").

rules.title: Hover-only menus
rules.text: Menus open on click or tap and keyboard as well as hover, and do not close when the pointer slips off for a moment.

rules.title: Mega menus without structure
rules.text: Large menus have grouped, labelled columns; never a wall of links.

rules.title: Different navigation on every page
rules.text: The header and its order stay the same across the site. Only the current marker changes.

rules.title: Links that open new tabs by default
rules.text: Internal links stay in the same tab. External links open in the same tab too unless leaving would lose work.
